The Deal Sheet

Acme Data Centers agreed to be acquired by Example Infrastructure Partners for $12.4 billion including debt, a 28% premium to the undisturbed share price. The buyer is funding the deal with a mix of equity from its latest fund and a $6 billion term loan.

Analysts said the price implies roughly 24x forward EBITDA, reflecting scarcity of powered land near major hyperscaler campuses.
